description: This file defines the 'RequestForwardableException' class, which extends the base Exception class and implements HttpExceptionInterface. It is used for handling exceptions related to forwarding requests within the OrangeHRM Core Controller layer, encapsulating controller details, attributes, query data, status code, and headers.

classes.name: RequestForwardableException
